subject: 湖州飞英塔外塔
caption: 飞英塔 · 外塔
完整外立面 · 南宋重建
source_note: 画可见七层外塔，完整塔刹与底层廊檐；不绘内塔、不臆造剖面。去掉遮挡树木、游客，少量屋面线表达屋顶走向。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural illustration for the heritage collection 访古. Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER ONLY: the existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant delicate slightly organic thin black strokes, restrained detail, large white surfaces and quiet visual density. Image 2 is an actual photograph of the NAMED MONUMENT and is GEOMETRY ONLY.
Create sparse fine BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE, all surfaces and openings WHITE. Confident thin exterior contours and fewer finer interior structural lines. No solid black fills, no shadows, no gray shading, no hatching, no pencil grain, texture or gradients, no color. Simplify repetitive ornament; do not trace every brick, tile, rafter or weathered patch. Roof and wall surfaces should stay predominantly blank. Preserve the actual identifying geometry, proportions and present condition. Remove tourists, trees, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, fences, surrounding buildings and sky. No text, calligraphy, labels, captions, dimension marks, watermark or border. A few short ground strokes only.
Portrait 1024x1536, whole tower and base occupy about 82% of canvas height with margins, full apex and footings uncut; centered near-frontal with minimal perspective.
SUBJECT: the visible OUTER Feiying Pagoda in Huzhou, Zhejiang, China, a Southern Song rebuilt octagonal brick-and-timber pavilion pagoda. Exactly SEVEN roofed storeys. Draw the complete exterior, not the internal stone pagoda and not a cutaway. The base floor has a particularly broad low hipped roof over its surrounding veranda. Above this are SIX smaller roofed storeys with octagonal railings around each, for SEVEN total roofs. The seven independent roof planes taper gently, with slightly lifted corners and thin selective tile-edge detail. Keep the long complete metal finial with spindle-shaped stacked discs, jewel-shaped top and the slender support chains from its crown to the top roof corners; these are architectural, not utility wires. Copy the real visible door/window placement and upper balconies. Preserve the generous ground-floor veranda, columns and low plinth; remove foliage masking its right side but retain the reference-supported symmetry. Count roof bands from the large veranda roof upwards: 1,2,3,4,5,6,7. Make all SEVEN eave silhouettes visible and separate with a wall-and-railing section between them. Repeated roof tiles should not fill the roof planes; black timbers in photo become delicate outlines around white spaces. No invented surrounding buildings.

historical_sources.title: 湖州市文旅局 · 地名里的湖州③
historical_sources.supports: 外塔南宋重建有嘉泰1201—1204及端平初两说；塔中塔形成于开宝年间；1982—1987修缮，与主体断代区分。

site_recommendation.name: 飞英塔
site_recommendation.year_note: 1220为13世纪前期的近似排序位置，并非确定竣工年；湖州文旅局列嘉泰1201—1204与端平初两种记载。
site_recommendation.place: 浙江 · 湖州 · 吴兴
site_recommendation.lede: 飞英塔外塔以七层八角木檐包裹内部石塔，宽大的底层廊檐托起逐级收分的塔身。层间栏杆与修长塔刹勾出湖州古城的标志性轮廓。
facts: 图版聚焦外塔，按南宋重建登记；重建纪年有嘉泰年间与端平初两说，不强填某个确年。
外塔为七层八角砖木楼阁式塔，内部保存独立石塔，形成著名的“塔中塔”。
历代屡经修缮，1982—1987年的保护修理延续其砖木混合结构，不能将修缮年当作古塔初建年。

quality_check.notes: 从底部廊檐至顶部共七个完整屋顶，塔刹与牵引链完整，无剖面。
